what.a: Partnerly is an AI business operating system: it connects entrepreneurs, co-founders, investors and professionals and helps them build companies together, faster.

how.q: How does the AI match work?
how.a: Our AI analyses skills, goals, industry, availability and values to compute compatibility. Every match is always explained, never just a number.

free.a: Yes. The Free plan is free forever and includes 10 matches a month, one project and community access. No card required.

italy.a: Exactly. Partnerly is Italian by design: copy, cities, industries and community are built for the Italian market, in Italian and English.

data.a: Security is a priority. We use enterprise-grade authentication and never share your data without your consent.
